description:
Accepts Friend Request using the reviewed player revision.
Use when: the player explicitly requests this social action.
Not for: automatic retries after timeout, automatic acceptance of crossed requests or changing expectedRevision without reconciling intent.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken. A current snapshot revision and its exact requestId.
Side effects: Consumes the exact incoming request and any crossed request, creates the friendship on both sides and sends an ordinary confirmation atomically. No automatic retry. Repeating the same revision cannot create a second effect.
Returns: Complete {userId,revision,friendCode,friends,incoming,outgoing,blocked,limits,serverTime} snapshot. Replace the matching host/project/player cache. lastActiveAt is the latest retained login, null when unknown; it is not online presence.
Errors: 409 REVISION_CONFLICT or an uncertain response: get a new snapshot and reconcile intent, never silently replace expectedRevision and repeat. 404 FRIEND_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND means this request was removed or replaced; do not act on a newer ID. INBOX_FULL rejects the entire send/accept. Friend/request/block capacity limits reject additions while existing data remains removable. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

expectedRevision.description: Exact revision from the reviewed actor snapshot; never refresh and substitute automatically

requestId.description: Exact request ID from the reviewed incoming/outgoing snapshot

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken sent only as Authorization Bearer

targetUserId.description: The other player UUID in the same project

userId.description: Signed-in player UUID matching the session

name: horizon_accept_friend_request
title: Accept Friend Request
